title: Poultry Farmers Combat AMR Through Training
reason: The video describes a training program aimed at reducing antimicrobial resistance in poultry production.

tasks.task: Implement a training program to improve poultry health without using antibiotics.

subtasks.text: Explain the global public health threat of antimicrobial resistance (AMR).
Describe the interventions designed by FAO and the Kenyan government to combat AMR in poultry production.
Outline the farmer-field-school approach used to train poultry farmers.
Highlight the focus on improving hygiene and biosecurity in the training program.
Present the success of the training program, with farmers producing eggs free from antimicrobial residues.

tasks.task: Show the transformation of farmers through the training program.

subtasks.text: Demonstrate Steven Gechohimboro's adoption of new practices and cessation of drug use.
Showcase the celebrating farmers during the graduation ceremony.
